data.one_liner: Extremely fast NoSQL database for Flutter with async support and static typing.
data.what_it_does: Isar is a NoSQL database built for Flutter and desktop. It provides ACID semantics, compile-time checked queries, full-text search, and real-time database watchers.
use_when: You need a fast, local NoSQL database with complex query capabilities in Flutter.
You require real-time data streaming via database watchers.
You want compile-time type-checked queries and auto-generated collection schemas.
avoid_when: You require traditional relational SQL tables with complex joins.
You are targeting web platforms with this specific version (web support is not present in 3.0.0+).
strengths: Built-in support for embedded objects, multi-entry indexes, and full-text search.
weaknesses: Requires passing an explicit directory when opening instances (since 3.1.0).
data.setup_notes: Add isar, isar_flutter_libs, and isar_generator with build_runner to your pubspec.yaml, then annotate your models with @collection.

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: You prefer a traditional, lightweight SQLite relational database approach.

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: You want a robust, type-safe SQL database builder for Dart and Flutter.

alternatives.name: shared_preferences
alternatives.why_pick_it: You only need to store simple key-value pairs rather than complex object graphs.
